findings.classification: 可证符号口径不一致

topics.read_status: Journal PDF 15 pages obtained; named original theoretical sections actually read. Conference source relevant passages checked. No RFS implementation executed.
findings: LMB is union of independent labelled Bernoulli components, with static unique birth-time/index labels. Measurement model is point-target at most one detection per target with Poisson clutter.

Independent LMB birth and disjoint label spaces permit closed LMB prediction. Measurement update is generally not closed: LMB approximates full delta-GLMB posterior by matching labelled first moments.

Per-label existence/spatial marginals and expected cardinality are preserved; full cardinality distribution and cross-label dependence generally are not. Grouping is approximate; all close targets in one group can require full delta-GLMB-like update.
Current book broad independence/label discussion is consistent. Do not claim labels alone recover permanent physical speaker identity.

independent_calculation.interpretation: Association produces negative existence dependence lost by independent Bernoulli approximation.

remaining: No multi-target data/system run; not recommending wholesale new RFS chapter expansion.

findings: Original paper enumerates S! assignments, chooses minimum total pairwise MSE and optimizes that particular MSE. It does not assert convexity or convex subgradient validity.

Unique strictly winning smooth branch gives ordinary branch gradient. At equal assignments one needs an explicit tie/autodiff convention; continuous parameter values alone do not guarantee measure-zero ties when heads/symmetries coincide.

independent_calculation.convex_subgradient_contradiction: Supporting inequality at theta=1 requires g<=-1; at theta=-1 requires g>=1; no convex subgradient exists at0.
independent_calculation.qualification: Clarke generalized gradient of this locally Lipschitz function is [-2,2], so selecting a branch is compatible with that different generalized notion. Do not claim all notions of generalized derivative fail.

remaining: No need to introduce full nonsmooth-analysis subchapter; concise branch-gradient explanation and tie policy suffice.

findings.title: 无约束协方差MLE等于样本协方差需正定条件

findings.title: 旋转结果键名把列向量作用顺序写反

findings.title: 实状态Kalman默默截断复协方差虚部
findings.evidence: q_cov/r_cov/p_prev由Hermitian校验接受复数后直接.real；独立输入Q=[[1,.2j],[-.2j,1]],F=H=I,P=R=I,s=z=0被接受，predicted_cov=2I，虚相关被无提示丢弃。
findings.recommendation: 实状态合同应先拒绝非零虚部协方差；如扩展复状态需全链共轭转置与复状态校验，不静默改模型。

findings.title: NNLS返回字段与full KKT verification措辞过强
findings.evidence: P=[[1,.5],[.5,1]],b=[1,-.2],max_iters=1返回q_opt=[.4,.133333],dual_min=-.266667,互补残差.106667；没有converged/status，未满足KKT仍以opt命名。默认练习通过，不把有限预算情形称默认结果错误。
findings.recommendation: 返回收敛标志、已执行迭代数与诊断容差；预算耗尽时明确近似值。可将q_opt改solution或加状态；补一项有意义的有限预算测试。

findings.title: 英文ILD误区行否定范围反向
findings.evidence: 中文:295是误以为低于固定频率物理上绝对不存在声级差；英文Assuming zero physical level difference can ever exist...变成“零声级差可以存在”是误区。
findings.recommendation: 改为Assuming ILD must always be zero below a fixed frequency，与中文及同表低频非零ILD例一致。

findings.title: 1.4kHz行为ITD上限与听神经锁相混为一层
findings.evidence: 正文:234、304、306和图1c将特定纯音双耳任务约1.4kHz上限叙成听神经锁相硬截止。实际读Brughera2013方法/结果支持行为阈值；Johnson1980原研究摘要为猫听神经记录至6kHz以下；Verschooten/Joris2014原研究引言明确人体AN外周细结构上限当时未知且本实验只研究猫1kHz。不能从行为阈值直接推出所有听神经锁相上限，也不能用猫数字定人体硬截止。
findings.recommendation: 图1c与正文用“人类利用纯音细结构作双耳ITD辨别的行为上限约1.4kHz（给定实验）”；神经层级另标模型与物种。4kHz包络例仅说明包络线索与载波细结构线索不同。
findings.limits: 没有在本轮取得Bernstein2003正文或人体AN实际新数据；不据此裁定4kHz生理绝对截止。

findings.title: 阶梯缩小时差被叫作降难度
findings.evidence: 连续3次正确后缩小差异实际提高辨别难度，正文两次称降难度。79.4%标准结论正确；p^3是把3连对或首次错视为更新块时的全对概率，不是任意单试次向下更新概率。
findings.recommendation: 改为下调时差/提高难度；若保留简推，说明独立固定p、同等上下步长的更新事件平衡近似，文献实际有限步阶梯不等同无限稳态。

findings.title: 英文never equals把一般不等误写成绝不相等
findings.evidence: per-bin dB arithmetic averaging never equals broadband ILD为假：若所有频点左右响应幅比相同，所有频点dB平均与宽带功率比dB相等；例如左右完全相同均为0dB。中文:722仅说不能充当，语义强度较准确。
findings.recommendation: 改为does not generally equal/cannot generally substitute for broadband ILD；保留当前−5.90dB数例。

findings.title: 声压校准不足以得到声功率W
findings.evidence: Pa²与W维度不同；灵敏度和SPL标定只识别局部声压。声功率需表面声强积分，或另给自由场/阻抗/几何面积假设；同一点同压可对应不同辐射功率。
findings.recommendation: 将此处限为Pa²；若讲W另列声强与面积/空间积分及其假设。

findings.title: 相同双耳输出必丧失所有方位感过强
findings.evidence: ILD/IPD在有效频点归零的代数正确；“所有空间方位感/全部集中头中”未排除原信号单耳谱形、动态线索及既有外化线索，本章:317恰解释单耳谱形可辅助方向。
findings.recommendation: 限为左右差异线索丢失，通常趋向正中/内化；不要保证所有刺激、所有听者一律无方位感。

findings.title: 泄气孔声阻统称1/f闪烁需原器件模型支持
findings.evidence: 晶体管flicker与MEMS机械/声学热噪声不是同一来源；本章无原厂PSD/声阻热噪声模型来支持两者普遍严格1/f。练习明给1/f数学模型的计算仍正确。
findings.recommendation: 寻找原始MEMS噪声建模/器件数据；无该依据时将1/f设为选定模型，并分开ASIC闪烁与声学阻尼热噪声。

findings.title: 连续渐近与精确离散结果差的来源可更完整
findings.evidence: 原3.0625与3.179328数值正确。独立把因素拆开：连续精确sin约3.0527846543，离散渐近3.1891153375，离散精确3.1793282391；说明段只突出端点加权，尚有小角近似误差（反向抵消约.0098）。
findings.recommendation: 补一句同时含离散求积与小角近似误差；若需教学可给四格对照，不改现准确最终结果。

new_findings.problem: Wilson expression is defined for all k but its nominal 95% coverage is approximate, so Eq11-5 plus Bonferroni cannot establish at-least95% finite-sample joint coverage. n1 p.75 counterexample gives75%.

new_findings.proposal: 保留通用安全上界名称，或给受限字母表精确最小位宽 floor(log2 G)+1 unsigned / floor(log2 G)+2 signed；G为正整数。R16/64原答案不变。

findings.verdict: 独立重算确认，限定正文解释而非否定Joseph实现
findings.claim: 任意增益（含依当前残差的双讲门控）仍给出精确真实后验协方差。
findings.why: B=I-KH及K依当前e，不能移到对u,v的期望之外；条件于门控后u,v的二阶矩/交叉项也改变。
findings.recommendation: 增益须给定或相对于先验信息可测，且所用条件二阶矩正确；区分PSD矩阵传播和真实MSE。固定给定R的现有实现不因本解释错误改算法。

findings.verdict: 归因确认；新梯度问题须合并同一修订，不扩大成局部4点算法不可能
findings.evidence: 2014原文明确扩展2013 Wiener LN为Hammerstein NL；作者仍只更新当前span四点，但链式导数为C^T U_i,n w，U收同span及重叠span的历史局部向量。

independent_calculation.example: L=2,h=[1,1]，当前与上一输入均u=1/2、同span，三次均匀B样条

findings.recommendation: 分列2013 LN、2014 NL；将y=u^TCq及C^Tu限定为样条块输出/2013 Wiener最终输出；若讲Hammerstein整链则补历史矩阵与局部坐标更新。
findings.rejected_stronger_claim: 撤回“NL必须每拍更新全部历史span、不能仅4点”的说法；作者2014算法明确选择当前span局部坐标。2014完整全文实验/证明未全读，不能称全篇核验。

findings.verdict: 可复算的解释条件遗漏
findings.evidence: 投影G对角均值1/2只表示秩/维数比，不推出任意候选更新的能量约减半，更不能由此直接推出稳定裕度。
findings.limits: 附加控制只反驳同块欧氏误差必收缩；不据此声称固定输入多步一定发散。核心docstring已把0≤μ<2标为接口守卫，不是全局稳定定理。
findings.recommendation: 保留精确投影与非交换推导；若要说平均减半，明确各向同性候选增量等统计模型；实际稳定范围用目标输入与实现检验。

findings.verdict: 边界措辞错误
findings.evidence: K_n≤L且U满列秩时，解空间维数L−K_n；只有K_n<L无穷多解，K_n=L唯一。
findings.independent_calculation: U=I_2,e=[1,2]，U^TΔw=e唯一Δw=[1,2]；E06-21正文自身2×2交点也已正确。
findings.recommendation: 拆成欠定与方阵两种情况，公式6-13/6-14不必改。

findings.verdict: 恒等条件缺失且全静音分母边界待明示
findings.evidence: α=1、Φvv=0时仍有max(Gmin,ξ/(1+ξ))，不是无条件纯Wiener；且Φee=0时原比值0/0，增益地板不能修复先发生的除零。
findings.recommendation: 写成带地板Wiener；地板未激活时才与纯Wiener相等。为静音说明有效能量门控/旁路/冻结功率更新，不伪造物理功率。
findings.cross_check: E06-32正确保留max且数表有钳位，代码固定正噪声PSD并未触发0/0；不把该练习判错。

findings.verdict: 冻结频响的结论被推广到真实LTV
findings.evidence: 冻结a的有理频响|A|=1正确；随时间调制的递推不是同一个LTI频响，不保证逐频幅度或无频谱侧带。表格自身承认颤音/声像游移。
findings.recommendation: 将式后结论限于冻结系数近似，说明慢调制减少而不消除可闻/幅度扰动；满秩只由给定五点例证明，非任意输入或调制普遍保证。

findings.verdict: 标准时延量需准确命名
findings.evidence: 15ms限制是监听位置直接声首波与ICC增强声首波到达时间差ΔRx，不是笼统的嘴到耳增强链总延迟。
findings.independent_calculation: 直接声到达6ms、增强声到达20ms，则ΔRx=14ms满足该项；把总延迟20ms直接与15ms比较会判反。
findings.recommendation: 明确定义τloop在梳状滤波公式中为两路相对时差；若代码保留总增强时延字段则另减直接传播时间再判本条要求。保留ANSI/其他整机条件未核边界，不称单阈值完成标准认证。

findings.verdict: 独立反驳后保留：最优地板值正确，论证用词错误
findings.evidence: f'(λ)=(λ−a)/λ²；在λ>a为正故函数递增，但导数并非单调递增。
findings.recommendation: 以可行区间上f'(λ)>0说明边界最优；不改max(a,λmin)。

findings.verdict: 原延迟路径矩阵满行秩条件冲突，独立反例
findings.evidence: 书中先保留公共传播延迟，再称双麦Nh阶路径Nu=Nh−1的原Sylvester方阵严格满行秩，条件只排非零有限z公共根及末抽头全零；公共首部零会强制第一行全零。
findings.recommendation: 先剥公共纯延迟并删除对应零约束，用约化多项式与阶数陈述满秩/互素；或只对目标延迟向量在原矩阵列空间中的可解性作结论，不把存在特定延迟解等同满行秩。
findings.limits: 只对正文已声明的单源双路径边界作反例；一般多源MINT原论文全文尚未本轮核。

findings.verdict: 区分时间预测破坏与空间相位
findings.evidence: 共同非零实标量γt对所有麦相乘时，Xm/Xref精确不变；逐通道正实增益改变相对幅度但不直接旋转同频相对相位。正文后续时延不交换推导成立，不能用它证明RTF相位毁坏。
findings.recommendation: 共同时变增益损坏固定跨帧预测；分通道增益改变空间幅度/估计统计，零增益丢信息；改写复谱/波形的网络还可能改变相位。不要把所有情形写成必然破坏相位。
findings.limits: 两章中英文全文本轮均已读；本反例限给定同帧正实标量增益，不证明任意波形网络、时变跨频系统或统计估计器保持RTF。其他未读全书消费者另列。

findings.verdict: 回拉保持正定/抑制膨胀正确，彻底消除复声过冲的普遍保证不成立
findings.evidence: 任意δ>0和0≤β≤1的凸回拉只趋于δ^-1I；若目标逆矩阵过大，仍可产生很大的恢复增益。示例δ=1的局部成功不能推广。
findings.recommendation: 改称抑制静音造成的逆矩阵膨胀；安全先验δ、恢复更新限幅/渐开和输入能量分布必须另验，不能写彻底根除。
findings.limits: 本控制验证所列RLS代数条件，未称完整声学时序录音；现有E07-20人工回归向量也需同真实历史契约区分。
findings.scope_clarification: 1474行是δ=1给定算例的结论，算例数值本身保留；实证反驳针对635行对任意允许参数的普遍保证。

findings.verdict: 7-18到7-20省略固定加载与衰减先验的区别
findings.evidence: 7-18定义g=(R+δI)^−1r且δ≥0。随后7-20以Ψ=R^−1推g=Ψr而未注明δ=0/初始先验条件。固定δ时A_t=R_t+δI=αA_(t−1)+qqH/λ+(1−α)δI，不仅是rank1。core单步只有初始inverse，不实现每步固定δ。
findings.recommendation: 明确7-20对应无固定加载而非零初始先验递推；若需固定δ，说明额外对角补项与求解成本。区分7-21静音回拉先验目标与持续固定ridge。
findings.limits: 独立分数运算，未改或执行仓内生成器。

findings.verdict: 英文仍保留坐标下降保证驻点的过强说法
findings.evidence: 英文381声称exact coordinate descent on a nonconvex objective guarantees stationary points；中文对应已写不能保证全局但不承诺无条件驻点。英文还把flooring一律排除，然而E07-09正确称max(a,λmin)是固定可行域上的精确受约束最小化。
findings.independent_calculation: 对可行初始λ≥λmin，先精确最小化G再对每个λ取max(a,λmin)，有J(Gnext,λnext)≤J(Gnext,λold)≤J(Gold,λold)。这是下降而非无条件迭代/驻点收敛定理。
findings.recommendation: 对齐R129的正则性条件与受约束目标；区分floor的精确受约束更新、平滑以及不匹配加载。
findings.limits: 未以这条反驳所有WPE收敛理论，仅核该句无条件保证。

findings.verdict: 英文把对数功率也写成严格正
findings.evidence: 英文power spectra and natural log-powers ... are strictly positive；题内ω=π功率1/4，对数ln(1/4)<0。中文全谱严格为正指功率谱，表达较接近原意。
findings.recommendation: 英文仅称power spectra strictly positive，因此log存在且逐点相同。
findings.limits: 实倒谱非唯一性推导和数值不受影响。

findings.verdict: 中文把一般实可微函数一阶驻点条件写成极值充要条件
findings.evidence: 中文实值实微可微函数取得极值的充要条件是∂J/∂g*=0。一般只是一阶必要条件；本段具体PSD二次LS可凭凸性给充分性。英文stationary points表述正确。
findings.recommendation: 写一般为驻点条件；再用当前二次代价凸性说明正规方程解是全局最小。

findings.verdict: 独立确认：标准T20为60dB外推值，当前字段/附录把20dB历时命名T20；第2章当前说明正确
findings.evidence: 本轮直接打开ISO26101-2:2024原标准公开预览，PDF页8§3.1 Note2（网页文本187–197），明确小动态范围拟合后外推60dB，−5到−25记T20；该节引源ISO3382-2:2008§3.5。room_metrics全文161行确认返回t20_s=−20/slope，而measured_t60_from_t20仅返回−60/slope，现有T60数值无须乘3。

findings.recommendation: 同步中英符号、字段语义与依赖测试；保留历史JSON与既有−60/slope数值。第7章786仅交叉链接附录，改链接说明即可；第2章436当前正确定义应保留。
findings.limits: 未读ISO3382-2完整收费标准；本轮room_metrics全文与附录853–925、第二章426–445；消费者rg已列出，尚未逐文件完整跟踪全部。

findings.verdict: 固定原C源码静态核实的英文同步漂移
findings.claim: 英文称轮转时域约束FFT/IFFT可将transform cost减半。

findings.claim: 全局傅里叶变换丢失/erases temporal dynamics
findings.challenge: 保留完整复谱时变换可逆，并未丢失时间信息；只是全局幅谱本身不显式定位局部时间。建议区分表达不便与信息丢失。
findings.independent_calculation: 任意x，IDFT(DFT x)=x；时间平移只改变复相位，完整复谱保留定位信息，幅谱才丢绝对时序。
findings.recommendation: 改为整段幅谱难以直接观察时间变化，不能说完整傅里叶变换丢失时间信息。

findings.claim: L_s ln2 > T60足以避免谐波尾声侵入线性响应
findings.challenge: T60定义60dB衰减不是严格RIR支持尾长；要无重叠应按保留脉冲响应长度/容许底噪及各谐波支持设计。尚待原文实读核条件。
findings.source_evidence: Farina2000 §2 PDFp5 lines234–239要求每个谐波响应时间支撑无重叠；T60不是严格响应长度。
findings.recommendation: 按保留IR尾长/噪声阈值设计间隔；T60只能作为给定衰减及容许残差下的近似预算。

findings.challenge: 本轮尚未实际读取录音逐个互协方差符号；只有总和为正不足以支持全部240项正。将直接读PCM复算。
findings.recommendation: 改成240个交叉项的总和为正，不改正确总功率表；表内实际导出PCM功率与未量化算术平均功率另分。

findings.claim: bessel_j0宣称所有有限float64绝对误差<1e−14
findings.evidence: 浮点先算chi=x−π/4会丢小相移；独立用(cos x+sin x)/sqrt(pi x)避免该差分，DLMF10.17.1–3/iii给领先项及余项界。现测试只取0,root,pi,18.5,29,42,64不能支持全float64。不是ch00的另一个实现。
findings.recommendation: 稳健旋转分解相位并避免8*x/pi*x中间上溢；对允许max_terms预算给误差/未收敛状态，或明确收窄支持范围；保留普通声学频率原例。

additional_independent_calculation.note: 正常实数12已超过声明1e-14，不仅超大参数问题；Decimal独立180项幂级数

findings.claim: 两个等强源间距小于HPBW必融合成单峰

independent_calculation.model: 两等功率互不相干源，精确总体DS扫描功率sum_i|a(scan)^H a(source_i)/8|²，无噪声/无有限快拍误差

findings.recommendation: 将HPBW称经验分辨尺度；是否双峰取决于相干性、功率比、具体阵因子和判据，不作硬阈值。

findings.claim: 所有零点都由各路相位恰好成对抵消
findings.independent_calculation: 三麦单位权psi=2pi/3，1+exp(j2pi/3)+exp(j4pi/3)=0，无任意一对互为负数。
findings.recommendation: 改为各路复矢量和为零，成对抵消只是部分例子。

findings.claim: 二维实测DI
findings.evidence: core只对给定J0二维相干矩阵做解析/数值求解；未读取任何舱内录音。英语1450为Actual 2D DI，没有翻译成measured，中文越过证据层级。
findings.recommendation: 改二维模型下DI/按二维协方差计算的DI；保留表内数值。

findings.claim: 任意2D/3D规则阵的复制主峰只要落进色散球内部就出现栅瓣
findings.challenge: 三维平面波k可见集是球面，固定完整三维格点倒格矢须使k0+G再次落在同球面；球内部一般不对应相同频率传播波。平面阵投影才是可见圆盘/球面沿法向自由提升，需分开。待第3章相关段核对。
findings.independent_calculation: 独立完整3D立方格，倒易间距1.5κ、d=2λ/3、k0=(κ,0,0)。k0−1.5κex=(-.5κ,0,0)在球内，枚举[-2,2]^3无其他复制落在球面；范围外任意坐标模≥2κ故无需搜索。对该固定指向无可传播别名。
findings.recommendation: 把平面阵投影圆盘与完整三维色散球面分开；完整三维检查复制峰落在球面，不能用球内作为充分条件。

findings.claim: Fisher信息公式缺高斯误差似然前提
findings.challenge: OLS协方差211仅需二阶矩；213的Fisher信息不由协方差唯一决定。
findings.recommendation: 补零均值高斯TOA/TDOA误差，分开OLS协方差与Fisher信息；不判OLS本式错误。

findings.claim: 中文将更新与求逆同写O(M²)
findings.challenge: 英文同处正确O(M²)存储/更新、O(M³)稠密逆/EVD；中文396后文也正确。
findings.recommendation: 同步中文266复杂度，不扩大为全章算力错误。

findings.claim: 把|sinθ−sinθ0|<λ/d称栅瓣条件
findings.challenge: 存在等高复制应为sinθ−sinθ0=nλ/d，n非零整数；后续d<λ/(1+|sinθmax|)上界和数例本身正确。
findings.recommendation: 改用整数等式推出无栅瓣上界；不改正确最终结果。

findings.claim: 离开设计频率必须聚焦或离网格重建
findings.challenge: 固定物理整数网格p*d0每频仍可直接用频变虚拟流形。独立p=[0,1,3],d0=.04m,u=sin[-20°,35°],P=[1,.6],noise=.1；1/2kHz虚拟矩阵直接等于各频真流形协方差，误差<2.5e−16。
findings.recommendation: 说明逐频独立处理可行；跨频相干汇合到统一流形才需要聚焦或相应整合。

findings.claim: 近九成分贝电平
findings.challenge: 0.3643幅度约−8.77dB，百分比不能描述分贝损失；英文nearly9dB正常。
findings.recommendation: 写电平下降约8.8dB；若百分比，区分幅度损失63.6%和功率86.7%。

findings.claim: 按倍频程切换子阵就实现恒定束宽
findings.challenge: 9麦并集与无栅瓣上限正确。但独立5麦等权d=.08m，1kHz HPBW45.480682°，2kHz22.288264°。roughly量级相近不等于恒定，缺频变权/过渡融合。
findings.recommendation: 补权重、频段过渡及容差，或称跨倍频程维持相近束宽量级。产品更常用普遍性未查到原证据。

findings.claim: 低高频实测时差与具体频带反推
findings.challenge: baffle_and_vent.py175–244为纯公式LF/HF极限算例；精确模求和仅20/200Hz检查，无实测录音。<400Hz/>3kHz统一近似精度未定。
findings.recommendation: 中文表头改模型预测或极限；频带注明示意及误差范围。英文表头无measured，不需机械同步替换。

findings.claim: 高通有限参数比值溢出未拒绝
findings.challenge: acoustic_vent_highpass([1e308],1e-308)输入通过后返回nan+nanj，数学响应近1+0j。当前25/80Hz算例正确。
findings.recommendation: 用稳定比值分支并校验输出finite，或明确拒绝不支持范围。

findings.claim: tau_10_sphere_s未注明主值相位时差
findings.challenge: 函数−Arg(p1/p0)/(2πf)不做展开。a=.05m,θ30°,8kHz为−33.1635us，20Hz为−218.6817us；任意频率不可直接当无模糊脉冲到达。当前只20/200Hz验证LF，不能据此指控当前验证HF出错。
findings.recommendation: 字段文档说明wrapped phase delay；宽带需另定义展开、群延迟/脉冲到达。

findings.claim: 商用6+1核心原因归因于J0零阶模态
findings.challenge: 中心麦在J0近零仍可观测为合理机制；未核到具体产品原设计支撑核心原因这种因果断言。
findings.recommendation: 称中心麦的一个益处或补原厂设计证据，不判数学机制错误。

This explains altered timing sensitivity but does not prove all slips undetectable; damaged patch content can still alter NSIM. Chinese562 limits claim to score not substituting for timing/continuity measurement.
findings.proposal: Match Chinese: internal alignment means the quality score cannot replace direct latency or continuity measurement; remove universal cannot-detect assertion.

findings.status: confirmed source-meaning drift; no physical device run
findings.claim: corresponding far-end frame must reach AEC strictly before acoustic echo arrives at physical microphone
findings.evidence: Official manual Echo Cancellation140 and Troubleshooting167 require reference availability before canceller processes corresponding echo, not before physical arrival. Its own example writes soundcard, reads captured frame, then calls synchronous cancellation with both frames. Header68–135 exposes synchronous arrays and optional two-frame internal playback buffer, not physical wall-clock deadline. Replaying already recorded aligned arrays remains possible.
findings.proposal: Require reference/frame history available when processing mic frame and adequate causal filter coverage; keep physical ADC/DAC time mapping separate.

new_findings.title: 视听曝光关联被当作在线可用帧，存在未计入的前视
new_findings.status: confirmed actual helper + independent last-arrived calculation
new_findings.reason: 当前公式floor((ta-offset)/Tv)选最近曝光中心，却声称直接根据到达时刻流式取帧。按自己声明arrival=(m+.5)Tv+offset，不少selected frame尚未到达；prestartmax0还提前借用了未来frame0。会改变E15-11和图83的在线丢辅音计数。
new_findings.proposal: 明确离线最近中心关联与在线last-arrived策略；流式输出须有available timestamp/valid bit或缓冲延迟。按既定中心到达模型m=floor((ta-offset)/Tv-.5)，不夹成尚未到达的0；实际整帧曝光还须按完成时间计时。相应重算题例/图/报告/直接测试。

new_findings.title: 单讲含噪SCM与干扰加噪SCM的GEVD不等价于减背景噪声
new_findings.reason: Rsolo=Rs+Rnn，但Rvv=Ri+Rnn，基线噪声不同。即使a,b均单位模且精确统计，principalGEV再用Rvv回着色得到[1,.80179-.59761j]，不是目标[1,1]。前段正交强干扰特例不能支撑一般等价。
new_findings.proposal: 若使用单讲Rsolo则与同背景Rnn做GEVD再提取目标RTF；或用含同Rvv的Rx与Rvv做标准rankoneGEVD。Rvv仍用于最终MVDR。分开正交白噪特例与一般输入。

new_findings.title: 固定槽位的总DER身份下界不能一概称漏检下界
new_findings.status: confirmed actual DER core; 256-hypothesis independent enumeration also preserves existing2/7 value
new_findings.reason: 三个非重叠说话人复用两个槽时可Miss=0/FA=0/Confusion=1。固定全局1对1身份匹配确实令总DER>=最短未匹配时长/总时长，但未匹配身份活动可成为Confusion而非全是Miss。
new_findings.proposal: 将379及COVERAGE的硬性漏检改为总DER/身份错误下界。E15-13的2/7与oracle两个Miss帧正确可保留，明确是一个达到下界的oracle构造，勿声称任何达到下界的输出都漏完整第三人。

new_findings.title: 非零视觉权重不能保证性能不低于纯音频
new_findings.reason: 凸组合只保证掩码落[0,1]且alpha=0时精确退回纯音频。已给例audio=.82,AV=.05,alpha=.05→.7815，对理想1误差更大；E15-15 partialposterior .68997<.88080，只是仍超过.5。
new_findings.proposal: 把绝对性能保证改成‘alpha趋0时退回基线；本例避免判决翻转’；如果产品要保证不劣于基线，必须定义可测的触发准则/评价并验证，不能由凸性直接推出。

new_findings.title: 软排他门控降低污染但不确保零污染
new_findings.status: confirmed literal nonzero mask and current figure/report
new_findings.reason: 该帧目标排他权重.1411827仍非零，重叠观测及其干扰外积继续进入SCM；完全正确的因子化概率也不把软权重变成oracle0/1。
new_findings.proposal: 将‘确保…不受重叠污染’改为‘降低重叠污染，让单讲帧主导’；E15-10已经使用‘显著抑制’的表述可保留；勿借此重复新增独立性防御段。

new_findings.title: MuSE被归入交叉注意力Transformer/自监督唇动不符所引原文
new_findings.reason: 原MuSE为Conv3D+预训练唇读ResNet18/V-TCN、上采样、迭代A-TCN与自注册嵌入；不是跨注意力Transformer。预训练唇读也不能无依据称自监督。
new_findings.proposal: 拆开MuSE的迭代音视频自注册方案与AV-SepFormer的交叉注意力。保留条件线索的教学公式。

new_findings.title: 两章生成器缺少解析字段的独立写前核对
new_findings.reason: 独立固定波形、float与PCM均校验，但analytic_expectations直接从同一生成report拷入。内存把解析MSE/NMSE改99，两prepare_assets均不拒绝。完整同源回放不独立否定生成源自身解析公式漂移。
new_findings.proposal: 增加不调用同一解析实现的固定解析期望校验，涵盖目标失真/干扰/传感器噪声分量及总误差，先校验再mkdir。加只改解析字段的负控。现有图和WAV正确，不必把此项写成已发布坏值。

new_findings.title: SAD采样矩阵归一化未定义导致与SN3D上下文冲突
new_findings.reason: D=Y/L只有在适当球面均值正交N3D基下得到YᵀD=I。按本章SN3DY=[1,u]四面体，实际diag(1,1/3,1/3,1/3)；MMD有阶因子3，与E14-14增益推导一致。标准正交积分归一还会有4π。
new_findings.proposal: 就在定义Y时写明归一化/配对信号规范；若沿用SN3D给出阶权因子。不要把上游spaudiopy带能量定标的SAD数值机械等同本书MMD。t>=2N+1用于能量矢量条件，谐波乘积正交t>=2N应分清。

findings.evidence: ZH uses 7.5 cm 环径 (diameter), EN translates to 7.5 cm radius circular array but retains 5.28 kHz. For regular hexagon nearest-neighbor distance equals circumradius; critical f=c/(sqrt(3)*d). c=343, diameter=.075 gives d=.0375 and f=5280.83046 Hz; radius=.075 gives2640.41523 Hz.
findings.recommendation: EN radius改diameter，保留现有约5.28kHz和严格临界不等号；不把此翻译错误泛化为Tucker原定理错误。
findings.limits: local geometry independent calculation; no new original full-paper reading or noisy performance execution

findings.status: confirmed incorrect English additional condition; original numerical counterexample retained
findings.evidence: EN appends caveat 'when ker(R) intersection {a}^perp is nontrivial'. In its own R=diag(0,1),a=[1,1] example that intersection is {0}, yet pseudoinverse point [0,1] has power1 and feasible nullspace point [1,0] has power0. The relevant condition is nonzero projection of a into kerR, not nonzero nullspace intersection with a-perp.
findings.derivation: PSD minimization with w^H a=1: if a_null=P_kerR a !=0, a_null/(a_null^H a) is zero-cost feasible; if a lies in rangeR, normalized R^+a is optimal and one may add any nullspace direction (all orthogonal to a). Example R=diag(0,0,1),a=e3 has nontrivial kerR intersection a-perp but pseudoinverse is optimal, refuting sufficiency too.
findings.recommendation: EN delete incorrect intersection condition or replace by explicit a-nullspace projection distinction, preserving counterexample and correct CN. Do not claim every pseudoinverse solution invalid.
findings.limits: exact given PSD optimization; no external original-source execution and no global all-case numeric stress test

# 全书多轮研究、审查与修订记录

## 任务与起点

2026-11-23，Asia/Shanghai。用户授权对全项目开展多代理、多轮研究、审查、交叉审查、修改及修改后复审，并按主题频繁提交和推送。起始提交为 `ba114e90cc8ce8a98d2ad4407351c2b6973e6d68`，起始工作区干净。

本记录集中保存研究依据、问题、改动计划和复审结果。子代理向主审提交结果，不另建分角色报告。历史审查、方法报告、固定来源和许可证保留原身份。

逐主题检索、原文定位、独立算例完整输入和后续复审结果集中保存在[统一证据附件](2026-11-23-multiround-evidence.json)。附件随本台账更新，各包明确已完成与未执行范围。

当前阶段：**R1/R1-B研究及R2分批独立审查已合并；全部38篇中英正文、278份章节Python和16份源README的同摘要实际阅读区间已闭合。测试、发布源和练习音频手册的最后交接正在核对，随后按合并问题制定逐项修复计划。正文与代码尚未开始修改，修改后复审及发布物验收均未完成**。

## 有限范围

固定起点清单见 [multiround-scope.json](2026-11-23-multiround-scope.json)。它逐篇保存中英源路径、源摘要、标题、编号公式和练习锚，逐行保存覆盖表的 388 条方法记录，并列出代码、测试、音频、图表和出版源文件。清单用于检查遗漏，不充当正确性或验收结果。

| 对象 | 起点数量 | 后续审查方式 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| 中英教程 | 各19篇 | 全文分块审读，核定义、推导、例题、引用、导航及译文 |
| 中英研究手册 | 各6篇 | 核实现身份、参数、来源与执行记录 |
| 方法覆盖记录 | 388条 | 按主题分组，保留各条适用范围与实现状态 |
| 稳定练习 | 360道 | 题干、答案、执行结果、独立期望及目录逐项对应 |
| 教学Python文件 | 278个 | 核唯一实现、调用关系、状态、数值边界与测试 |
| 测试文件 | 269个 | 区分独立期望、预期失败、跳过和实际执行 |
| 教材音频 | 283 WAV、32清单 | 按清单完整回放，核共同增益、PCM、窗口与分母 |
| 中英编号图 | 各87张 | 核生成计算、图文结论及最终尺寸下可读性 |
| 图表数值报告 | 35份 | 核真实源身份与独立数值路线 |
| 第一方出版源 | 41个 | 核Markdown、公式、版面、摘要、兼容锚及发布流程 |
| 源README | 16份 | 核实际命令、数量、边界和双语共有事实 |
| 上游来源 | 129 Git项、2归档项 | 核实际使用的固定版本与原始依据，保留原状态 |
| 发布物 | 双语各33 HTML、两份PDF及媒体 | 自动结构、实际浏览器与PDF页图分别记录 |

## 轮次安排与收敛条件

1. **R1主题研究**：按所有章节和覆盖表建立主题组，阅读当前论述、实现和既有报告，再检索并阅读原论文、官方源码与标准。记录具体公式、页节、版本、检索词、核实日期及采用或不采用材料的理由。
2. **R2独立审查**：交换研究分工，由不同代理质疑R1结论；完整审读全部章节及中英文对应内容，逐项检查公式、例题、图表、代码和格式。主审核章际接口、资料身份和出版链。
3. **改动计划**：合并去重问题，区分事实错误、教学缺口、实现错误与版面问题。每项列出源文件、直接消费者、修改方法、独立期望和验收办法，再按互斥文件分工。
4. **修改与复审**：先改源，再生成受影响资产；由未写入该文件的代理复审，并核对此前全部发现。按主题完成测试和产物验收后提交、推送。
5. **后续研究与交叉审查**：重新检查已修改结论、未采用候选、前轮遗漏和反例，扩大检查到直接依赖。新增问题进入同一台账，继续修改及复审。

至少完成两轮有不同审阅者参与的研究与审查。连续两轮独立复审没有新增需要修改的P0/P1/P2问题，既有问题均有真实处理结果，且所需数值、来源、网页与PDF检查完成，才判断收敛。发现新问题即继续，不以轮数、提交数或测试输出代替收敛。

阅读、独立复算、实际运行、来源核实、图页目视和听辨分别记录。全文提取、缩略图、结构扫描、原尺寸读图与逐页查看不互相替代。

"""Independent numerical regressions from the 2026-11-23 chapter review."""

from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
import math
import unittest
import warnings

import numpy as np

from codes.chapters.ch02.core.diffuse_and_fractional import bessel_j0
from codes.chapters.ch03.core.baffle_and_vent import acoustic_vent_highpass


def decimal_j0(value):
    """Independent high-precision series; never calls the production helper."""
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 100
        quarter_square = Decimal.from_float(float(value)) ** 2 / 4
        term = Decimal(1)
        total = term
        for index in range(1, 600):
            term *= -quarter_square / (index * index)
            total += term
            if abs(term) < Decimal("1e-90"):
                return float(total)
    raise AssertionError("independent J0 series did not converge")


class SpecialFunctionReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_j0_cancellation_and_allowed_series_budget(self):
        expected = 0.047689310796833535
        self.assertEqual(decimal_j0(12.0), expected)
        for budget in (20, 80):
            self.assertAlmostEqual(float(bessel_j0(12.0, max_terms=budget)),
                                   expected, delta=2e-15)

    def test_j0_branch_boundaries_against_decimal(self):
        values = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 4.0, np.nextafter(4.0, math.inf),
                           12.0, 56.0, np.nextafter(56.0, math.inf), 64.0, 100.0])
        expected = np.array([decimal_j0(value) for value in values])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(bessel_j0(values), expected, rtol=0, atol=3e-15)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(bessel_j0(-values), bessel_j0(values))

    def test_j0_large_finite_arguments_do_not_overflow(self):
        values = np.array([1e100, 1e308, np.finfo(float).max])
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
            actual = bessel_j0(values)
        self.assertTrue(np.all(np.isfinite(actual)))
        # The leading Hankel amplitude bounds these extremely large values;
        # this checks range handling, not a universal phase-accuracy claim.
        amplitude = math.sqrt(2 / math.pi) / np.sqrt(values)
        self.assertTrue(np.all(np.abs(actual) <= amplitude * (1 + 1e-14)))
        self.assertTrue(np.all(actual != 0))


class AcousticVentReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dc_cutoff_and_normal_frequency_response(self):
        np.testing.assert_allclose(acoustic_vent_highpass([0, 25, 50], 25),
                                   [0, 0.5 + 0.5j, 0.8 + 0.4j],
                                   rtol=0, atol=2e-16)

    def test_finite_extreme_ratios_have_stable_limits(self):
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
            high = acoustic_vent_highpass([1e308], 1e-308)[0]
            low = acoustic_vent_highpass([1e-308], 1e308)[0]
        self.assertEqual(high, 1)
        self.assertEqual(low, 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

+**Unified Wave-Vector $\vec k$-Space (`k-space`) Perspective**: Define the propagation **wave vector** $\vec k=-\kappa\vec u=-\frac{2\pi}{\lambda}\vec u$ ($\mathrm{rad/m}$), giving steering components $a_m(\vec k)=e^{-\mathrm{j}\vec k^\top(\vec r_m-\vec r_1)}$. In three dimensions, propagating far-field waves lie on the **dispersion sphere** $\|\vec k\|_2=\omega/c$. A planar array observes only in-plane components, whose projected visible region is a disk of radius $\omega/c$.
+
+For sensors on a regular spatial lattice, the response repeats across the corresponding **reciprocal lattice**. A replica produces a visible grating lobe when it reaches the appropriate visible set: the sphere surface for a complete three-dimensional wave vector, or the disk for the planar projection. A point strictly inside the sphere is not a three-dimensional propagation direction at that frequency. Applying the criterion with the stated geometry and field of view gives the ULA condition $d<\lambda/2$ and the regular-hexagon condition $d<\lambda/\sqrt{3}$ in Chapter 3 §3.2.2 (see Johnson & Dudgeon 1993 and Van Trees 2002).

"""Independent numerical regressions from the 2026-11-23 chapter review."""

from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
import math
import unittest
import warnings

import numpy as np

from codes.chapters.ch02.core.diffuse_and_fractional import bessel_j0
from codes.chapters.ch03.core.baffle_and_vent import acoustic_vent_highpass
from codes.chapters.ch08.core.separation_metrics_streaming import (
    causal_fir_toeplitz, ci_sdr_toeplitz, single_speaker_bypass_gate,
)


def decimal_j0(value):
    """Independent high-precision series; never calls the production helper."""
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 100
        quarter_square = Decimal.from_float(float(value)) ** 2 / 4
        term = Decimal(1)
        total = term
        for index in range(1, 600):
            term *= -quarter_square / (index * index)
            total += term
            if abs(term) < Decimal("1e-90"):
                return float(total)
    raise AssertionError("independent J0 series did not converge")


class SpecialFunctionReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_j0_cancellation_and_allowed_series_budget(self):
        expected = 0.047689310796833535
        self.assertEqual(decimal_j0(12.0), expected)
        for budget in (20, 80):
            self.assertAlmostEqual(float(bessel_j0(12.0, max_terms=budget)),
                                   expected, delta=2e-15)

    def test_j0_branch_boundaries_against_decimal(self):
        values = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 4.0, np.nextafter(4.0, math.inf),
                           12.0, 56.0, np.nextafter(56.0, math.inf), 64.0, 100.0])
        expected = np.array([decimal_j0(value) for value in values])

"""Independent numerical regressions from the 2026-11-23 chapter review."""

from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
import math
import unittest
import warnings

import numpy as np

from codes.chapters.ch02.core.diffuse_and_fractional import bessel_j0
from codes.chapters.ch03.core.baffle_and_vent import acoustic_vent_highpass
from codes.chapters.ch08.core.separation_metrics_streaming import (
    causal_fir_toeplitz, ci_sdr_toeplitz, single_speaker_bypass_gate,
)


def decimal_j0(value):
    """Independent high-precision series; never calls the production helper."""
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 100
        quarter_square = Decimal.from_float(float(value)) ** 2 / 4
        term = Decimal(1)
        total = term
        for index in range(1, 600):
            term *= -quarter_square / (index * index)
            total += term
            if abs(term) < Decimal("1e-90"):
                return float(total)
    raise AssertionError("independent J0 series did not converge")


class SpecialFunctionReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_j0_cancellation_and_allowed_series_budget(self):
        expected = 0.047689310796833535
        self.assertEqual(decimal_j0(12.0), expected)
        for budget in (20, 80):
            self.assertAlmostEqual(float(bessel_j0(12.0, max_terms=budget)),
                                   expected, delta=2e-15)

    def test_j0_branch_boundaries_against_decimal(self):
        values = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 4.0, np.nextafter(4.0, math.inf),
                           12.0, 56.0, np.nextafter(56.0, math.inf), 64.0, 100.0])
        expected = np.array([decimal_j0(value) for value in values])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(bessel_j0(values), expected, rtol=0, atol=3e-15)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(bessel_j0(-values), bessel_j0(values))

    def test_j0_large_finite_arguments_do_not_overflow(self):
        values = np.array([1e100, 1e308, np.finfo(float).max])
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
            actual = bessel_j0(values)
        self.assertTrue(np.all(np.isfinite(actual)))
        # The leading Hankel amplitude bounds these extremely large values;
        # this checks range handling, not a universal phase-accuracy claim.
        amplitude = math.sqrt(2 / math.pi) / np.sqrt(values)
        self.assertTrue(np.all(np.abs(actual) <= amplitude * (1 + 1e-14)))
        self.assertTrue(np.all(actual != 0))

    def test_j0_near_hankel_boundary_keeps_approximation_error_explicit(self):
        # Independent review found a larger omitted-term error here than at
        # the other selected points. This is a finite regression, not a bound
        # for the whole asymptotic interval.
        self.assertAlmostEqual(float(bessel_j0(57.5)), decimal_j0(57.5),
                               delta=8e-15)


class AcousticVentReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dc_cutoff_and_normal_frequency_response(self):
        np.testing.assert_allclose(acoustic_vent_highpass([0, 25, 50], 25),
                                   [0, 0.5 + 0.5j, 0.8 + 0.4j],
                                   rtol=0, atol=2e-16)

    def test_finite_extreme_ratios_have_stable_limits(self):
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
            high = acoustic_vent_highpass([1e308], 1e-308)[0]
            low = acoustic_vent_highpass([1e-308], 1e308)[0]
        self.assertEqual(high, 1)
        self.assertEqual(low, 0)


class SeparationMetricReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ci_sdr_scores_the_full_convolution_tail(self):
        reference = np.array([1., 0., -1., 0.])
        estimate = np.array([1., -1., 1., -1.])
        result = ci_sdr_toeplitz(estimate, reference, 4)
        expected_filter = np.array([1., -1., 2., -2.]) / 3
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["filter_taps"], expected_filter, atol=1e-15)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["target_projection"],
                                   np.convolve(reference, expected_filter), atol=1e-15)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["target_energy"], 4/3)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["residual_energy"], 8/3)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["ci_sdr_db"], -10 * math.log10(2))
        self.assertEqual(result["evaluation_samples"], 7)
        # The old cropped fit remains an explicitly different objective.
        cropped = causal_fir_toeplitz(reference, 4, full_convolution=False)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(cropped @ [1, -1, 2, -2], estimate)

    def test_full_convolution_matrix_matches_independent_direct_convolution(self):
        reference, taps = np.array([2., -1., 3.]), np.array([1., 4., -2.])
        actual = causal_fir_toeplitz(reference, 3)
        self.assertEqual(actual.shape, (5, 3))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual @ taps, np.convolve(reference, taps))

    def test_gate_keeps_large_finite_ratio_and_reports_energy_overflow(self):
        slots = np.array([[1e308, -1e308], [1e307, -1e307]])
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
            result = single_speaker_bypass_gate(slots)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["secondary_to_primary_ratio"], 0.01)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["secondary_to_primary_db"], -20)
        self.assertTrue(result["bypass"])
        self.assertEqual(result["energy_representation"], ["overflow", "overflow"])
        self.assertIsNone(result["primary_energy"])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["output_waveforms"][0], [1.1e308, -1.1e308])

    def test_gate_preserves_log_ratio_when_linear_ratio_underflows(self):
        result = single_speaker_bypass_gate([[1e308, 0.], [1e-308, 0.]])
        self.assertTrue(result["ratio_underflow"])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["secondary_to_primary_db"], -12320)
        self.assertEqual(result["energy_representation"], ["overflow", "underflow"])
        self.assertTrue(result["bypass"])

    def test_gate_rejects_an_unrepresentable_merged_waveform(self):
        top = np.finfo(float).max
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "merged slot"):
            single_speaker_bypass_gate([[top], [top * 0.01]])


class TrackingReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_psd_acceptance_is_scale_consistent(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch09.core.echo_av_fusion import _checked_psd_2x2
        for scale in (1e-200, 1e-16, 1., 1e200):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                _checked_psd_2x2(np.diag([-scale, scale]))
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(_checked_psd_2x2(np.diag([0., scale])),
                                          np.diag([0., scale]))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            _checked_psd_2x2(np.array([[1, 1j], [-1j, 1]]))
        maximum = np.finfo(float).max
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(_checked_psd_2x2(np.eye(2)*maximum),
                                      np.eye(2)*maximum)

    def test_ospa_tiny_positive_distance_is_preserved_in_both_entries(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch09.core.echo_av_fusion import angular_ospa_distance
        from codes.chapters.ch09.chapter09_experiments import small_set_distances
        for delta in (1e-200, 1., 9.):
            expected = delta
            self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([0], [delta], order=2), expected)
            self.assertEqual(small_set_distances([0], [delta], order=2)['ospa'], expected)
        self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([], [], order=2), 0)
        self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([], [30], order=2), 10)
        self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([179], [-179], order=2), 2)

    def test_lifecycle_rejects_skipped_frames_and_declares_hop(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch09.core.lifecycle import teaching_lifecycle
        def frames(starts):
            return {'start_sample': starts, 'observation_valid': [True]*len(starts),
                    'state_time_s': [(2*x+511)/32000 for x in starts],
                    'available_time_s': [2*(x+512)/32000 for x in starts]}
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'hop_samples'):
            teaching_lifecycle(frames([0,1600,3200]))
        result = teaching_lifecycle(frames([0,160,320]))
        self.assertEqual(result['parameters']['hop_samples'], 160)
        self.assertEqual(result['events'][-1]['event'], 'confirmed')
        result = teaching_lifecycle(frames([0,80,160]), hop_samples=80)
        self.assertEqual(result['events'][-1]['frame'], 2)

    def test_mht_symmetric_branch_predictions_remain_tied(self):
        branches = (([41.,39.], [10.,-10.]), ([39.,41.], [10.,-10.]))
        squared_errors = [float(np.sum((np.array(pos)+vel-[50.,30.])**2))
                          for pos, vel in branches]
        self.assertEqual(squared_errors, [2., 2.])

    def test_miss_penalty_and_maximum_cardinality_are_distinct_objectives(self):
        # Two gated matches cost 16; one zero-cost match and one miss cost 9.
        full_matching = 8+8
        optional_missed_detection = 0+9
        self.assertLess(optional_missed_detection, full_matching)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Independent numerical regressions from the 2026-11-23 chapter review."""

from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
import math
import unittest
import warnings

import numpy as np

from codes.chapters.ch02.core.diffuse_and_fractional import bessel_j0
from codes.chapters.ch03.core.baffle_and_vent import acoustic_vent_highpass
from codes.chapters.ch08.core.separation_metrics_streaming import (
    causal_fir_toeplitz, ci_sdr_toeplitz, single_speaker_bypass_gate,
)


def decimal_j0(value):
    """Independent high-precision series; never calls the production helper."""
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 100
        quarter_square = Decimal.from_float(float(value)) ** 2 / 4
        term = Decimal(1)
        total = term
        for index in range(1, 600):
            term *= -quarter_square / (index * index)
            total += term
            if abs(term) < Decimal("1e-90"):
                return float(total)
    raise AssertionError("independent J0 series did not converge")


class SpecialFunctionReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_j0_cancellation_and_allowed_series_budget(self):
        expected = 0.047689310796833535
        self.assertEqual(decimal_j0(12.0), expected)
        for budget in (20, 80):
            self.assertAlmostEqual(float(bessel_j0(12.0, max_terms=budget)),
                                   expected, delta=2e-15)

    def test_j0_branch_boundaries_against_decimal(self):
        values = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 4.0, np.nextafter(4.0, math.inf),
                           12.0, 56.0, np.nextafter(56.0, math.inf), 64.0, 100.0])
        expected = np.array([decimal_j0(value) for value in values])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(bessel_j0(values), expected, rtol=0, atol=3e-15)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(bessel_j0(-values), bessel_j0(values))

    def test_j0_large_finite_arguments_do_not_overflow(self):
        values = np.array([1e100, 1e308, np.finfo(float).max])
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
            actual = bessel_j0(values)
        self.assertTrue(np.all(np.isfinite(actual)))
        # The leading Hankel amplitude bounds these extremely large values;
        # this checks range handling, not a universal phase-accuracy claim.
        amplitude = math.sqrt(2 / math.pi) / np.sqrt(values)
        self.assertTrue(np.all(np.abs(actual) <= amplitude * (1 + 1e-14)))
        self.assertTrue(np.all(actual != 0))

    def test_j0_near_hankel_boundary_keeps_approximation_error_explicit(self):
        # Independent review found a larger omitted-term error here than at
        # the other selected points. This is a finite regression, not a bound
        # for the whole asymptotic interval.
        self.assertAlmostEqual(float(bessel_j0(57.5)), decimal_j0(57.5),
                               delta=8e-15)


class AcousticVentReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dc_cutoff_and_normal_frequency_response(self):
        np.testing.assert_allclose(acoustic_vent_highpass([0, 25, 50], 25),
                                   [0, 0.5 + 0.5j, 0.8 + 0.4j],
                                   rtol=0, atol=2e-16)

    def test_finite_extreme_ratios_have_stable_limits(self):
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
            high = acoustic_vent_highpass([1e308], 1e-308)[0]
            low = acoustic_vent_highpass([1e-308], 1e308)[0]
        self.assertEqual(high, 1)
        self.assertEqual(low, 0)


class SeparationMetricReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ci_sdr_scores_the_full_convolution_tail(self):
        reference = np.array([1., 0., -1., 0.])
        estimate = np.array([1., -1., 1., -1.])
        result = ci_sdr_toeplitz(estimate, reference, 4)
        expected_filter = np.array([1., -1., 2., -2.]) / 3
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["filter_taps"], expected_filter, atol=1e-15)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["target_projection"],
                                   np.convolve(reference, expected_filter), atol=1e-15)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["target_energy"], 4/3)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["residual_energy"], 8/3)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["ci_sdr_db"], -10 * math.log10(2))
        self.assertEqual(result["evaluation_samples"], 7)
        # The old cropped fit remains an explicitly different objective.
        cropped = causal_fir_toeplitz(reference, 4, full_convolution=False)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(cropped @ [1, -1, 2, -2], estimate)

    def test_full_convolution_matrix_matches_independent_direct_convolution(self):
        reference, taps = np.array([2., -1., 3.]), np.array([1., 4., -2.])
        actual = causal_fir_toeplitz(reference, 3)
        self.assertEqual(actual.shape, (5, 3))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual @ taps, np.convolve(reference, taps))

    def test_gate_keeps_large_finite_ratio_and_reports_energy_overflow(self):
        slots = np.array([[1e308, -1e308], [1e307, -1e307]])
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
            result = single_speaker_bypass_gate(slots)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["secondary_to_primary_ratio"], 0.01)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["secondary_to_primary_db"], -20)
        self.assertTrue(result["bypass"])
        self.assertEqual(result["energy_representation"], ["overflow", "overflow"])
        self.assertIsNone(result["primary_energy"])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["output_waveforms"][0], [1.1e308, -1.1e308])

    def test_gate_preserves_log_ratio_when_linear_ratio_underflows(self):
        result = single_speaker_bypass_gate([[1e308, 0.], [1e-308, 0.]])
        self.assertTrue(result["ratio_underflow"])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["secondary_to_primary_db"], -12320)
        self.assertEqual(result["energy_representation"], ["overflow", "underflow"])
        self.assertTrue(result["bypass"])

    def test_gate_rejects_an_unrepresentable_merged_waveform(self):
        top = np.finfo(float).max
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "merged slot"):
            single_speaker_bypass_gate([[top], [top * 0.01]])


class TrackingReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_psd_acceptance_is_scale_consistent(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch09.core.echo_av_fusion import _checked_psd_2x2
        for scale in (1e-200, 1e-16, 1., 1e200):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                _checked_psd_2x2(np.diag([-scale, scale]))
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(_checked_psd_2x2(np.diag([0., scale])),
                                          np.diag([0., scale]))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            _checked_psd_2x2(np.array([[1, 1j], [-1j, 1]]))
        maximum = np.finfo(float).max
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(_checked_psd_2x2(np.eye(2)*maximum),
                                      np.eye(2)*maximum)

    def test_ospa_tiny_positive_distance_is_preserved_in_both_entries(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch09.core.echo_av_fusion import angular_ospa_distance
        from codes.chapters.ch09.chapter09_experiments import small_set_distances
        for delta in (1e-200, 1., 9.):
            expected = delta
            self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([0], [delta], order=2), expected)
            self.assertEqual(small_set_distances([0], [delta], order=2)['ospa'], expected)
        self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([], [], order=2), 0)
        self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([], [30], order=2), 10)
        self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([179], [-179], order=2), 2)

    def test_lifecycle_rejects_skipped_frames_and_declares_hop(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch09.core.lifecycle import teaching_lifecycle
        def frames(starts):
            return {'start_sample': starts, 'observation_valid': [True]*len(starts),
                    'state_time_s': [(2*x+511)/32000 for x in starts],
                    'available_time_s': [2*(x+512)/32000 for x in starts]}
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'hop_samples'):
            teaching_lifecycle(frames([0,1600,3200]))
        result = teaching_lifecycle(frames([0,160,320]))
        self.assertEqual(result['parameters']['hop_samples'], 160)
        self.assertEqual(result['events'][-1]['event'], 'confirmed')
        result = teaching_lifecycle(frames([0,80,160]), hop_samples=80)
        self.assertEqual(result['events'][-1]['frame'], 2)

    def test_mht_symmetric_branch_predictions_remain_tied(self):
        branches = (([41.,39.], [10.,-10.]), ([39.,41.], [10.,-10.]))
        squared_errors = [float(np.sum((np.array(pos)+vel-[50.,30.])**2))
                          for pos, vel in branches]
        self.assertEqual(squared_errors, [2., 2.])

    def test_miss_penalty_and_maximum_cardinality_are_distinct_objectives(self):
        # Two gated matches cost 16; one zero-cost match and one miss cost 9.
        full_matching = 8+8
        optional_missed_detection = 0+9
        self.assertLess(optional_missed_detection, full_matching)


class AecWpePremiseReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_projection_trace_does_not_set_every_vector_energy(self):
        projection = np.diag([1., 0.])
        self.assertEqual(np.trace(projection)/2, .5)
        self.assertEqual(np.sum((projection @ [1.,0.])**2), 1.)
        self.assertEqual(np.sum((projection @ [0.,1.])**2), 0.)

    def test_floor_derivative_sign_not_global_increase(self):
        a = 2.
        first = lambda value: (value-a)/value**2
        self.assertGreater(first(3.), 0)
        self.assertGreater(first(5.), first(10.))
        candidates = np.array([3., 4., 6.])
        values = a/candidates + np.log(candidates)
        self.assertEqual(int(np.argmin(values)), 0)

    def test_fixed_loading_has_extra_identity_term(self):
        old = np.array([[2.,.5],[.5,1.]])
        q = np.array([1.,2.]); alpha, loading, power = .7, .4, 2.
        actual = alpha*old + np.outer(q,q)/power + loading*np.eye(2)
        adjusted = alpha*(old+loading*np.eye(2)) + np.outer(q,q)/power
        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual-adjusted, (1-alpha)*loading*np.eye(2), atol=1e-15)

    def test_common_gain_preserves_spatial_ratio_but_not_fixed_temporal_model(self):
        frame = np.array([1.+2j, 3.-1j])
        np.testing.assert_allclose((.3*frame)[1]/(.3*frame)[0], frame[1]/frame[0])
        self.assertNotEqual(.3*2., .1*2.)

    def test_shared_leading_delay_changes_mint_target_feasibility(self):
        matrix = np.array([[0.,0.],[1.,2.],[1.,-1.]])
        early = np.array([1.,0.,0.]); delayed = np.array([0.,1.,0.])
        early_fit = matrix @ np.linalg.lstsq(matrix, early, rcond=None)[0]
        delayed_fit = matrix @ np.linalg.lstsq(matrix, delayed, rcond=None)[0]
        self.assertEqual(float(np.linalg.norm(early_fit-early)), 1.)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(delayed_fit, delayed, atol=1e-15)

    def test_positive_power_need_not_have_positive_log_and_small_ridge_is_large_inverse(self):
        self.assertLess(math.log(.25), 0)
        self.assertEqual(1/1e-8, 1e8)

    def test_icc_report_names_listener_arrival_difference(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch06.core.nonlinear_and_stereo import stereo_decorrelation_and_loop_deadlines
        result = stereo_decorrelation_and_loop_deadlines()
        cases = result['loop_deadlines']['icc_itu_t_p1150']['cases']
        for case, expected in zip(cases, (10.,25.)):
            self.assertEqual(case['reinforced_first_arrival_ms']-case['direct_first_arrival_ms'], expected)
            self.assertEqual(case['arrival_difference_ms'], expected)
            self.assertEqual(case['meets_arrival_difference_limit'], expected<15)
            self.assertNotIn('itu_t_p1150_compliant', case)

def decimal_j0(value):
    """Independent high-precision series; never calls the production helper."""
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 100
        quarter_square = Decimal.from_float(float(value)) ** 2 / 4
        term = Decimal(1)
        total = term
        for index in range(1, 600):
            term *= -quarter_square / (index * index)
            total += term
            if abs(term) < Decimal("1e-90"):
                return float(total)
    raise AssertionError("independent J0 series did not converge")


class SpecialFunctionReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_j0_cancellation_and_allowed_series_budget(self):
        expected = 0.047689310796833535
        self.assertEqual(decimal_j0(12.0), expected)
        for budget in (20, 80):
            self.assertAlmostEqual(float(bessel_j0(12.0, max_terms=budget)),
                                   expected, delta=2e-15)

    def test_j0_branch_boundaries_against_decimal(self):
        values = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 4.0, np.nextafter(4.0, math.inf),
                           12.0, 56.0, np.nextafter(56.0, math.inf), 64.0, 100.0])
        expected = np.array([decimal_j0(value) for value in values])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(bessel_j0(values), expected, rtol=0, atol=3e-15)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(bessel_j0(-values), bessel_j0(values))

        values = np.array([1e100, 1e308, np.finfo(float).max])

        # The leading Hankel amplitude bounds these extremely large values;
        # this checks range handling, not a universal phase-accuracy claim.
        amplitude = math.sqrt(2 / math.pi) / np.sqrt(values)
        self.assertTrue(np.all(np.abs(actual) <= amplitude * (1 + 1e-14)))
        self.assertTrue(np.all(actual != 0))

    def test_j0_near_hankel_boundary_keeps_approximation_error_explicit(self):

def decimal_j0(value):
    """Independent high-precision series; never calls the production helper."""
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 100
        quarter_square = Decimal.from_float(float(value)) ** 2 / 4
        term = Decimal(1)
        total = term
        for index in range(1, 600):
            term *= -quarter_square / (index * index)
            total += term
            if abs(term) < Decimal("1e-90"):
                return float(total)
    raise AssertionError("independent J0 series did not converge")


class SpecialFunctionReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_j0_cancellation_and_allowed_series_budget(self):
        expected = 0.047689310796833535
        self.assertEqual(decimal_j0(12.0), expected)
        for budget in (20, 80):
            self.assertAlmostEqual(float(bessel_j0(12.0, max_terms=budget)),
                                   expected, delta=2e-15)

    def test_j0_branch_boundaries_against_decimal(self):
        values = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 4.0, np.nextafter(4.0, math.inf),
                           12.0, 56.0, np.nextafter(56.0, math.inf), 64.0, 100.0])
        expected = np.array([decimal_j0(value) for value in values])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(bessel_j0(values), expected, rtol=0, atol=3e-15)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(bessel_j0(-values), bessel_j0(values))

    def test_j0_large_finite_arguments_do_not_overflow(self):
        values = np.array([1e100, 1e308, np.finfo(float).max])
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
            actual = bessel_j0(values)
        self.assertTrue(np.all(np.isfinite(actual)))
        # The leading Hankel amplitude bounds these extremely large values;
        # this checks range handling, not a universal phase-accuracy claim.
        amplitude = math.sqrt(2 / math.pi) / np.sqrt(values)
        self.assertTrue(np.all(np.abs(actual) <= amplitude * (1 + 1e-14)))
        self.assertTrue(np.all(actual != 0))

    def test_j0_near_hankel_boundary_keeps_approximation_error_explicit(self):
        # Independent review found a larger omitted-term error here than at
        # the other selected points. This is a finite regression, not a bound
        # for the whole asymptotic interval.
        self.assertAlmostEqual(float(bessel_j0(57.5)), decimal_j0(57.5),
                               delta=8e-15)

"""Independent numerical regressions from the 2026-11-23 chapter review."""

from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
import math
import unittest
import warnings

import numpy as np

from codes.chapters.ch02.core.diffuse_and_fractional import bessel_j0
from codes.chapters.ch03.core.baffle_and_vent import acoustic_vent_highpass
from codes.chapters.ch08.core.separation_metrics_streaming import (
    causal_fir_toeplitz, ci_sdr_toeplitz, single_speaker_bypass_gate,
)


def decimal_j0(value):
    """Independent high-precision series; never calls the production helper."""
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 100
        quarter_square = Decimal.from_float(float(value)) ** 2 / 4
        term = Decimal(1)
        total = term
        for index in range(1, 600):
            term *= -quarter_square / (index * index)
            total += term
            if abs(term) < Decimal("1e-90"):
                return float(total)
    raise AssertionError("independent J0 series did not converge")


class SpecialFunctionReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_j0_cancellation_and_allowed_series_budget(self):
        expected = 0.047689310796833535
        self.assertEqual(decimal_j0(12.0), expected)
        for budget in (20, 80):
            self.assertAlmostEqual(float(bessel_j0(12.0, max_terms=budget)),
                                   expected, delta=2e-15)

    def test_j0_branch_boundaries_against_decimal(self):
        values = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 4.0, np.nextafter(4.0, math.inf),
                           12.0, 56.0, np.nextafter(56.0, math.inf), 64.0, 100.0])
        expected = np.array([decimal_j0(value) for value in values])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(bessel_j0(values), expected, rtol=0, atol=3e-15)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(bessel_j0(-values), bessel_j0(values))

    def test_j0_large_finite_arguments_do_not_overflow(self):
        values = np.array([1e100, 1e308, np.finfo(float).max])
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
            actual = bessel_j0(values)
        self.assertTrue(np.all(np.isfinite(actual)))
        # The leading Hankel amplitude bounds these extremely large values;
        # this checks range handling, not a universal phase-accuracy claim.
        amplitude = math.sqrt(2 / math.pi) / np.sqrt(values)
        self.assertTrue(np.all(np.abs(actual) <= amplitude * (1 + 1e-14)))
        self.assertTrue(np.all(actual != 0))

    def test_j0_near_hankel_boundary_keeps_approximation_error_explicit(self):
        # Independent review found a larger omitted-term error here than at
        # the other selected points. This is a finite regression, not a bound
        # for the whole asymptotic interval.
        self.assertAlmostEqual(float(bessel_j0(57.5)), decimal_j0(57.5),
                               delta=8e-15)


class AcousticVentReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dc_cutoff_and_normal_frequency_response(self):
        np.testing.assert_allclose(acoustic_vent_highpass([0, 25, 50], 25),
                                   [0, 0.5 + 0.5j, 0.8 + 0.4j],
                                   rtol=0, atol=2e-16)

    def test_finite_extreme_ratios_have_stable_limits(self):
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
            high = acoustic_vent_highpass([1e308], 1e-308)[0]
            low = acoustic_vent_highpass([1e-308], 1e308)[0]
        self.assertEqual(high, 1)
        self.assertEqual(low, 0)


class SeparationMetricReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ci_sdr_scores_the_full_convolution_tail(self):
        reference = np.array([1., 0., -1., 0.])
        estimate = np.array([1., -1., 1., -1.])
        result = ci_sdr_toeplitz(estimate, reference, 4)
        expected_filter = np.array([1., -1., 2., -2.]) / 3
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["filter_taps"], expected_filter, atol=1e-15)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["target_projection"],
                                   np.convolve(reference, expected_filter), atol=1e-15)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["target_energy"], 4/3)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["residual_energy"], 8/3)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["ci_sdr_db"], -10 * math.log10(2))
        self.assertEqual(result["evaluation_samples"], 7)
        # The old cropped fit remains an explicitly different objective.
        cropped = causal_fir_toeplitz(reference, 4, full_convolution=False)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(cropped @ [1, -1, 2, -2], estimate)

    def test_full_convolution_matrix_matches_independent_direct_convolution(self):
        reference, taps = np.array([2., -1., 3.]), np.array([1., 4., -2.])
        actual = causal_fir_toeplitz(reference, 3)
        self.assertEqual(actual.shape, (5, 3))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual @ taps, np.convolve(reference, taps))

    def test_gate_keeps_large_finite_ratio_and_reports_energy_overflow(self):
        slots = np.array([[1e308, -1e308], [1e307, -1e307]])
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
            result = single_speaker_bypass_gate(slots)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["secondary_to_primary_ratio"], 0.01)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["secondary_to_primary_db"], -20)
        self.assertTrue(result["bypass"])
        self.assertEqual(result["energy_representation"], ["overflow", "overflow"])
        self.assertIsNone(result["primary_energy"])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["output_waveforms"][0], [1.1e308, -1.1e308])

    def test_gate_preserves_log_ratio_when_linear_ratio_underflows(self):
        result = single_speaker_bypass_gate([[1e308, 0.], [1e-308, 0.]])
        self.assertTrue(result["ratio_underflow"])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(result["secondary_to_primary_db"], -12320)
        self.assertEqual(result["energy_representation"], ["overflow", "underflow"])
        self.assertTrue(result["bypass"])

    def test_gate_rejects_an_unrepresentable_merged_waveform(self):
        top = np.finfo(float).max
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "merged slot"):
            single_speaker_bypass_gate([[top], [top * 0.01]])


class TrackingReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_psd_acceptance_is_scale_consistent(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch09.core.echo_av_fusion import _checked_psd_2x2
        for scale in (1e-200, 1e-16, 1., 1e200):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                _checked_psd_2x2(np.diag([-scale, scale]))
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(_checked_psd_2x2(np.diag([0., scale])),
                                          np.diag([0., scale]))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            _checked_psd_2x2(np.array([[1, 1j], [-1j, 1]]))
        maximum = np.finfo(float).max
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(_checked_psd_2x2(np.eye(2)*maximum),
                                      np.eye(2)*maximum)

    def test_ospa_tiny_positive_distance_is_preserved_in_both_entries(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch09.core.echo_av_fusion import angular_ospa_distance
        from codes.chapters.ch09.chapter09_experiments import small_set_distances
        for delta in (1e-200, 1., 9.):
            expected = delta
            self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([0], [delta], order=2), expected)
            self.assertEqual(small_set_distances([0], [delta], order=2)['ospa'], expected)
        self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([], [], order=2), 0)
        self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([], [30], order=2), 10)
        self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([179], [-179], order=2), 2)

    def test_lifecycle_rejects_skipped_frames_and_declares_hop(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch09.core.lifecycle import teaching_lifecycle
        def frames(starts):
            return {'start_sample': starts, 'observation_valid': [True]*len(starts),
                    'state_time_s': [(2*x+511)/32000 for x in starts],
                    'available_time_s': [2*(x+512)/32000 for x in starts]}
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'hop_samples'):
            teaching_lifecycle(frames([0,1600,3200]))
        result = teaching_lifecycle(frames([0,160,320]))
        self.assertEqual(result['parameters']['hop_samples'], 160)
        self.assertEqual(result['events'][-1]['event'], 'confirmed')
        result = teaching_lifecycle(frames([0,80,160]), hop_samples=80)
        self.assertEqual(result['events'][-1]['frame'], 2)

    def test_mht_symmetric_branch_predictions_remain_tied(self):
        branches = (([41.,39.], [10.,-10.]), ([39.,41.], [10.,-10.]))
        squared_errors = [float(np.sum((np.array(pos)+vel-[50.,30.])**2))
                          for pos, vel in branches]
        self.assertEqual(squared_errors, [2., 2.])

    def test_miss_penalty_and_maximum_cardinality_are_distinct_objectives(self):
        # Two gated matches cost 16; one zero-cost match and one miss cost 9.
        full_matching = 8+8
        optional_missed_detection = 0+9
        self.assertLess(optional_missed_detection, full_matching)


class AecWpePremiseReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_projection_trace_does_not_set_every_vector_energy(self):
        projection = np.diag([1., 0.])
        self.assertEqual(np.trace(projection)/2, .5)
        self.assertEqual(np.sum((projection @ [1.,0.])**2), 1.)
        self.assertEqual(np.sum((projection @ [0.,1.])**2), 0.)

    def test_floor_derivative_sign_not_global_increase(self):
        a = 2.
        first = lambda value: (value-a)/value**2
        self.assertGreater(first(3.), 0)
        self.assertGreater(first(5.), first(10.))
        candidates = np.array([3., 4., 6.])
        values = a/candidates + np.log(candidates)
        self.assertEqual(int(np.argmin(values)), 0)

    def test_fixed_loading_has_extra_identity_term(self):
        old = np.array([[2.,.5],[.5,1.]])
        q = np.array([1.,2.]); alpha, loading, power = .7, .4, 2.
        actual = alpha*old + np.outer(q,q)/power + loading*np.eye(2)
        adjusted = alpha*(old+loading*np.eye(2)) + np.outer(q,q)/power
        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual-adjusted, (1-alpha)*loading*np.eye(2), atol=1e-15)

    def test_common_gain_preserves_spatial_ratio_but_not_fixed_temporal_model(self):
        frame = np.array([1.+2j, 3.-1j])
        np.testing.assert_allclose((.3*frame)[1]/(.3*frame)[0], frame[1]/frame[0])
        self.assertNotEqual(.3*2., .1*2.)

    def test_shared_leading_delay_changes_mint_target_feasibility(self):
        matrix = np.array([[0.,0.],[1.,2.],[1.,-1.]])
        early = np.array([1.,0.,0.]); delayed = np.array([0.,1.,0.])
        early_fit = matrix @ np.linalg.lstsq(matrix, early, rcond=None)[0]
        delayed_fit = matrix @ np.linalg.lstsq(matrix, delayed, rcond=None)[0]
        self.assertEqual(float(np.linalg.norm(early_fit-early)), 1.)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(delayed_fit, delayed, atol=1e-15)

    def test_positive_power_need_not_have_positive_log_and_small_ridge_is_large_inverse(self):
        self.assertLess(math.log(.25), 0)
        self.assertEqual(1/1e-8, 1e8)

    def test_icc_report_names_listener_arrival_difference(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch06.core.nonlinear_and_stereo import stereo_decorrelation_and_loop_deadlines
        result = stereo_decorrelation_and_loop_deadlines()
        cases = result['loop_deadlines']['icc_itu_t_p1150']['cases']
        for case, expected in zip(cases, (10.,25.)):
            self.assertEqual(case['reinforced_first_arrival_ms']-case['direct_first_arrival_ms'], expected)
            self.assertEqual(case['arrival_difference_ms'], expected)
            self.assertEqual(case['meets_arrival_difference_limit'], expected<15)
            self.assertNotIn('itu_t_p1150_compliant', case)


class IndependentR3FollowupTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_raw_gram_underflow_is_explicit_without_losing_valid_projection(self):
        for scale, representation in ((1., 'finite'), (1e-150, 'finite'),
                                       (1e-200, 'positive_diagonal_underflow'),
                                       (1e200, 'overflow')):
            result = ci_sdr_toeplitz([1., -1.], scale*np.array([1., -1.]), 1)
            self.assertEqual(result['gram_matrix_representation'], representation)
            self.assertEqual(result['rank'], 1)
            self.assertEqual(result['ci_sdr_db'], 120.)
            np.testing.assert_allclose(result['target_projection'], [1.,-1.], atol=1e-15)
            if representation == 'finite':
                self.assertAlmostEqual(result['gram_matrix'][0,0]/(scale*scale), 2.)
            else:
                self.assertIsNone(result['gram_matrix'])

    def test_unrepresentable_positive_ci_sdr_energy_is_not_reported_as_zero(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'positive unscaled CI-SDR energy'):
            ci_sdr_toeplitz([1e-200,-1e-200], [1.,-1.], 1)

    def test_principal_interval_preserves_adjacent_float_angles_and_set_members(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch09.core.tracking import wrap_angle
        from codes.chapters.ch09.core.echo_av_fusion import angular_ospa_distance, small_set_distances
        first = 100.; second = np.nextafter(first, math.inf)
        self.assertEqual(wrap_angle(first), first)
        self.assertEqual(wrap_angle(second), second)
        for order in (1,2):
            self.assertEqual(angular_ospa_distance([first], [second], order=order), second-first)
            self.assertEqual(small_set_distances([first], [second], order=order)['ospa'], second-first)
            self.assertEqual(small_set_distances([first,second], [first,second], order=order)['ospa'], 0.)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(wrap_angle([-540,-180,180,540]), [-180]*4)
        for value in (np.finfo(float).max, -np.finfo(float).max):
            self.assertTrue(-180 <= wrap_angle(value) < 180)


class SpatialNoiseAndPhaseReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_uca_radial_equalizer_requires_colored_noise_whitening(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch04.core.uca_cdr import uca_phase_mode_esprit, uca_steering_vector
        matrix = np.column_stack([uca_steering_vector(32, 1., angle) for angle in (-20.,45.)])
        signal = matrix @ np.diag([1.,.7]) @ matrix.conj().T
        for noise in (0.,1.,10.):
            estimates, _ = uca_phase_mode_esprit(signal+noise*np.eye(32), 1., n_sources=2)
            np.testing.assert_allclose(estimates, [-20.,45.], atol=1e-9)

    def test_dma_finite_extreme_input_returns_finite_weights_or_explicit_range_error(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch05.core.dma_kronecker import first_order_dma_weights
        for frequency, spacing, speed in ((1e308,.01,343.), (1e308,1e308,1.),
                                           (1e-308,1e-308,343.)):
            with warnings.catch_warnings():
                warnings.simplefilter('error', RuntimeWarning)
                try:
                    weights = first_order_dma_weights(frequency, spacing, 180., c=speed)
                except ValueError:
                    continue
            self.assertTrue(np.all(np.isfinite(weights)))


if __name__ == "__main__":

"""Independent output and executed-source controls for chapter-owned audit CLIs."""
import contextlib

import importlib
import os

import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace
import io
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
import wave

import numpy as np

from codes.chapters.ch01.examples import audit_libmysofa_loudness as loudness
from codes.chapters.ch06 import aec_doubletalk_experiment as doubletalk


class AuditOutputBoundaryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_loudness_rejects_formal_or_historical_report_before_compilation(self):
        for target in (loudness.LOCK, loudness.ROOT/'codes/chapters/ch01/reports/libmysofa_loudness.json'):
            with self.subTest(target=target), patch('sys.argv', ['audit', '--report', str(target)]), \
                 patch.object(loudness, 'run_audit') as run, self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                loudness.main()
            run.assert_not_called()

    def test_loudness_safe_external_report_and_symlink_parent(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            root = Path(name); target = root/'report.json'
            with patch('sys.argv', ['audit', '--report', str(target)]), \
                 patch.object(loudness, 'run_audit', return_value={'expected_behavior_observed': True}), \
                 contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                loudness.main()
            self.assertTrue(target.is_file())
            alias=root/'alias';alias.symlink_to(root,target_is_directory=True)
            with patch('sys.argv', ['audit', '--report', str(alias/'bad.json')]), \
                 patch.object(loudness, 'run_audit') as run, self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                loudness.main()
            run.assert_not_called()

    def test_doubletalk_rejects_unsafe_output_before_original_run(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            root=Path(name); pair=root/'inputs';pair.mkdir();library=root/'native.dylib';library.write_bytes(b'fixture')
            existing=root/'existing.wav';existing.write_bytes(b'preserve')
            alias=root/'alias';alias.symlink_to(root,target_is_directory=True)
            targets=[doubletalk.ROOT/'new.wav', pair/'new.wav', existing, alias/'new.wav']
            for target in targets:
                argv=['audit','--speex-library',str(library),'--pair-dir',str(pair),'--output-wav',str(target)]
                with self.subTest(target=target), patch('sys.argv',argv), patch.object(doubletalk,'run') as run, \
                     self.assertRaises((ValueError,FileExistsError)):
                    doubletalk.main()
                run.assert_not_called()
            self.assertEqual(existing.read_bytes(),b'preserve')

    def test_doubletalk_new_external_wav_is_exclusive_and_preserves_samples(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            root=Path(name);pair=root/'inputs';pair.mkdir();library=root/'native.dylib';library.write_bytes(b'fixture')
            target=root/'output'/'new.wav'
            argv=['audit','--speex-library',str(library),'--pair-dir',str(pair),'--output-wav',str(target)]
            with patch('sys.argv',argv), patch.object(doubletalk,'run',return_value=({},np.array([1,-2],dtype=np.int16))), \
                 contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                doubletalk.main()
            with wave.open(str(target),'rb') as wav:
                self.assertEqual((wav.getnchannels(),wav.getsampwidth(),wav.getframerate()),(1,2,16000))
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(np.frombuffer(wav.readframes(2),dtype='<i2'),[1,-2])
            with patch('sys.argv',argv), patch.object(doubletalk,'run') as run,self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                doubletalk.main()
            run.assert_not_called()

    def test_doubletalk_postflight_rejects_output_replaced_by_link(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            root=Path(name);pair=root/'inputs';pair.mkdir();library=root/'native.dylib';library.write_bytes(b'fixture')
            victim=root/'victim';victim.write_bytes(b'preserve');target=root/'new.wav'
            def original(*args):
                target.symlink_to(victim)
                return {},np.array([1],dtype=np.int16)
            argv=['audit','--speex-library',str(library),'--pair-dir',str(pair),'--output-wav',str(target)]
            with patch('sys.argv',argv), patch.object(doubletalk,'run',side_effect=original),self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                doubletalk.main()
            self.assertEqual(victim.read_bytes(),b'preserve')


class LcmvNormalizationReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_nonzero_response_cannot_disappear_during_column_normalization(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch05.core.beamforming import lcmv_weights
        for scale, response in ((1e308,1e-20),(1e200,1e-200)):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'normalization loses'):
                lcmv_weights(np.eye(2),scale*np.eye(2),np.full(2,response))
        np.testing.assert_allclose(lcmv_weights(np.eye(3),1e200*np.eye(3),np.full(3,1e200)),np.ones(3))
        np.testing.assert_allclose(lcmv_weights(np.eye(2),np.eye(2),[1.,2.]),[1.,2.])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(lcmv_weights(np.eye(2),np.eye(2),[0.,0.]),[0.,0.])


class OriginalPythonExecutionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_verified_source_executes_instead_of_valid_old_pyc_without_changing_it(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch04.core import upstream_contracts as contracts
        package_name='review_original_bytecode_fixture'
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            root=Path(name);package=root/package_name;package.mkdir();source=package/'__init__.py'
            source.write_text('value = 1\n');stamp=source.stat()
            cache=Path(py_compile.compile(str(source),doraise=True));old_cache=cache.read_bytes();old_mtime=cache.stat().st_mtime_ns
            source.write_text('value = 2\n');os.utime(source,ns=(stamp.st_atime_ns,stamp.st_mtime_ns))
            record={'python_files':{'source':{'path':str(source),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}}}
            sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
            try:
                normal=importlib.import_module(package_name);self.assertEqual(normal.value,1)
                sys.modules.pop(package_name)
                with contracts.source_imports(package_name,record):
                    actual=importlib.import_module(package_name)
                self.assertEqual(actual.value,2)
                self.assertEqual(actual.__micarray_original_source_sha256__,record['python_files']['source']['sha256'])
                self.assertEqual(cache.read_bytes(),old_cache);self.assertEqual(cache.stat().st_mtime_ns,old_mtime)
            finally:
                sys.path.remove(str(root));sys.modules.pop(package_name,None)

    def test_sourceless_bytecode_is_rejected_instead_of_executed(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch04.core import upstream_contracts as contracts
        package_name='review_sourceless_fixture'
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            root=Path(name);package=root/package_name;package.mkdir();source=package/'__init__.py'
            source.write_text('value=7\n');cache=package/'__init__.pyc';py_compile.compile(str(source),cfile=str(cache),doraise=True);source.unlink()
            saved=cache.read_bytes();sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
            try:
                with contracts.source_imports(package_name),self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'bytecode but no source'):
                    importlib.import_module(package_name)
                self.assertEqual(cache.read_bytes(),saved)
            finally:
                sys.path.remove(str(root));sys.modules.pop(package_name,None)

    def test_changed_source_is_rejected_before_its_body_runs(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch04.core import upstream_contracts as contracts
        package_name='review_rejected_source_fixture'
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            root=Path(name);package=root/package_name;package.mkdir();source=package/'__init__.py';victim=root/'executed'
            source.write_text('from pathlib import Path\nPath('+repr(str(victim))+').write_text("bad")\n')
            record={'python_files':{'source':{'path':str(source),'sha256':'0'*64}}}
            sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
            try:
                with contracts.source_imports(package_name,record),self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'execution bytes differ'):
                    importlib.import_module(package_name)
                self.assertFalse(victim.exists())
            finally:
                sys.path.remove(str(root));sys.modules.pop(package_name,None)

    def test_filterpy_same_filename_does_not_prove_preloaded_execution(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch09.examples import audit_tracking_upstream_interfaces as tracking
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            root=Path(name);package=root/'filterpy';package.mkdir();source=package/'__init__.py';source.write_text('value=1\n')
            identity={'checkout':str(root),'used_files':{'filterpy/__init__.py':{'sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}}}
            prior={k:v for k,v in sys.modules.items() if k=='filterpy' or k.startswith('filterpy.')}
            for k in prior:sys.modules.pop(k)
            try:
                with patch.dict(sys.modules,{'filterpy':SimpleNamespace(__file__=str(source))}):
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'lacks verified source-byte execution'):
                        tracking.loaded_filterpy_modules(identity)
            finally:
                for k in tuple(sys.modules):
                    if k=='filterpy' or k.startswith('filterpy.'):sys.modules.pop(k)
                sys.modules.update(prior)

    def test_said_executes_complete_verified_payload_without_loader_bytecode(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch04.examples import audit_said_compression as said
        if not (said.CACHE/'said/utils/compression.py').is_file():
            self.skipTest('optional pinned SAID source is unavailable')
        original_spec=said.importlib.util.spec_from_file_location
        loaders=[]
        def spec_without_executable_loader(name,path):
            result=original_spec(name,path)
            result.loader.exec_module=unittest.mock.Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('bytecode-capable loader used'))
            loaders.append(result.loader)
            return result
        with patch.object(said.importlib.util,'spec_from_file_location',side_effect=spec_without_executable_loader):
            result=said.build_report()
        for loader in loaders:loader.exec_module.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(result['scope']['executed_source_sha256'],
                         hashlib.sha256((said.CACHE/'said/utils/compression.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest())

    def test_pra_preflight_failure_prevents_package_method_execution(self):
        from codes.chapters.ch04.examples import audit_upstream_doa as doa
        with patch.object(doa,'verify_checkout',return_value={}), \
